resolution_notes: base_url: CONFIRM original. Amadeus's current official Test Data guide identifies test.api.amadeus.com as the Test base URL and api.amadeus.com as Production; the official authorization guide also uses https://test.api.amadeus.com/v1/security/oauth2/token. The HTTP 0 root check does not override endpoint-specific official documentation. Evidence: https://developers.amadeus.com/self-service/apis-docs/guides/developer-guides/test-data/ and https://developers.amadeus.com/self-service/apis-docs/guides/developer-guides/API-Keys/authorization/
